column1: # FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE, Asian release (0100B8A026F14000): the Korean / Chinese release of the game the registered JP profile (dm/games/0100606026F12000) covers.
# The same Unreal Engine 5.6.1 build at the same offsets (hle_uemalloc.c, patches.py), so the values and comments here follow the JP profile; the shader tables are this build's own.
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py) and brought up on the Mac (docs/agents); format: see dm/games/README.md
# 60 fps (30 on the Switch): the host writes rhi.SyncInterval 1 whenever the game sets it back (hle_fpslock.c), as the registered JP profile (dm/games/0100606026F12000)
# Unreal Engine 5.6.1: the allocator is replaced by the host's (hle_uemalloc.c layout UE5_6; the constructor call cut in patches.py) and the engine region capped at 4064 MB,
# as the registered JP profile: a 4064 MB region in the 5 GB guest block (256 MB in front + 4.375 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 128 MB heap region)
# the NPDM declares 20 MB of system resource
# A 3D field whose camera the right stick tilts and turns: the 3D pad layout. It plays docked (1920x1080)
# 2,077 vertex shaders (Unreal's particle vertex factories) pick one of several c2 table slots at run time (as the registered JP profile)
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
